data.content:
**TextField › Forward ref instead of inputRef prop** Change ref forwarding expectations on custom `inputComponent`. The component should forward the `ref` prop instead of the `inputRef` prop. ```diff -function NumberFormatCustom(props) { - const { inputRef, onChange, ...other } = props; +const NumberFormatCustom = React.forwardRef(function NumberFormatCustom( + props, + ref, +) { const { onChange, ...other } = props; return ( - - - + + ``` --- **ref › Fix ref type specificity** For some components, you may get a type error when passing `ref`. To avoid the error, you should use a specific element type. For example, `Card` expects the type of `ref` to be `HTMLDivElement`, and `ListItem` expects its `ref` type to be `HTMLLIElement`. Here is an example: ```diff import * as React from 'react'; import Card from '@mui/material/Card'; import ListItem from '@mui/material/ListItem'; export default function SpecificRefType() { - const cardRef = React.useRef(null); + const cardRef = React.useRef(null); - const listItemRef = React.useRef(null); + const listItemRef = React.useRef(null); return (
); } ``` Here are the specific element types that each component expects: #### @mui/material - [Accordion](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/accordion/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [Alert](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/alert/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [Avatar](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/avatar/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [ButtonGroup](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/button-group/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [Card](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/card/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [Dialog](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/dialog/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [ImageList](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/image-list/) - `HTMLUListElement` - [List](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/list/) - `HTMLUListElement` - [Tab](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/tab/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [Tabs](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/tabs/) - `HTMLDivElement` - [ToggleButton](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/toggle-button/) - `HTMLButtonElement` #### @mui/lab - [Timeline](https://v5.mui.com/material-ui/api/timeline/) - `HTMLUListElement`

**Autocomplete › Rename getOptionSelected (codemod)** Rename `getOptionSelected` to `isOptionEqualToValue` to better describe its purpose. ```diff option.title === value.title} + isOptionEqualToValue={(option, value) => option.title === value.title} ``` --- **Autocomplete › Update renderOption** `renderOption` should now return the full DOM structure of the option. It makes customizations easier. You can recover from the change with: ```diff ( - + renderOption={(props, option, { selected }) => ( +
  • {option.title} - +
    • )} /> ``` --- **Autocomplete › Rename reason arguments** The following values of the reason argument in `onChange` and `onClose` were renamed for consistency: 1. `create-option` to `createOption` 2. `select-option` to `selectOption` 3. `remove-option` to `removeOption` Change the CSS rules that use `[data-focus="true"]` to use `.Mui-focused`. The `data-focus` attribute is not set on the focused option anymore; instead, global class names are used. ```diff -'.MuiAutocomplete-option[data-focus="true"]': { +'.MuiAutocomplete-option.Mui-focused': { ```

content.text: The guide's "TextField › Forward ref instead of inputRef prop" section explains the estimate failure: v5 passes the input's ref as `ref`, not `inputRef`, so `DurationInput` never receives `estimateRef` and `create` reads an empty estimate. The Autocomplete failure is the v4 `getOptionSelected` key in the shared `personPickerProps`, which v5 renamed to `isOptionEqualToValue`. I'll fix both in the two local files.

input.old_text:
import { FocusEvent } from 'react';
import { InputBaseComponentProps } from '@mui/material';
input.new_text:
import { FocusEvent, forwardRef } from 'react';
import { InputBaseComponentProps } from '@mui/material';

input.old_text: getOptionSelected: (option: Person, value: Person) => option.id === value.id,
input.new_text: isOptionEqualToValue: (option: Person, value: Person) => option.id === value.id,
